scenes.text: Have you ever wanted absolute silence? Be careful what you wish for, because there is a soundproof room in Minnesota designed to block out ninety-nine percent of all sound, and the longest anyone has survived inside is just forty-five minutes.

Once you step inside, the silence quickly turns deafening as your body becomes the orchestra, allowing you to hear your own lungs breathing, your stomach gurgling, and even the blood rushing through your veins.
Soon, you lose your balance because there are no audio cues to help you stand, forcing your brain to create its own terrifying hallucinations just to keep from going mad in the dark.
Would you dare spend an hour inside this sensory deprivation chamber for a million dollars, or would you crack under the pressure? Tell us in the comments and follow for more!
